Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 124. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Melee Technique
Ki Cost: 5 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: melee
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Make an unarmed strike faster than can be precieved.
The target can not use their reaction in response to this
technique.
Roll a combo attack roll, dealing your unarmed strike
+ 2d6 damage on a success.
